svg.title: Ozzie Dynamics mark
svg.desc: Regular octagon, circumradius R, one vertex up. The D is built from it: horizontal bars run from the upper-left and lower-left vertices (offset R*sqrt(2)/2 from centre) to the vertical axis; the bowl is a semicircle centred on the octagon's centre with radius R*sqrt(2)/2, tangent to both bars; the stem stands halfway between the left vertices and the centre. Construction lines join opposite vertices.
